messages.content:
Risk: Governance failures
Description: The AI system may outpace regulatory frameworks and oversight mechanisms, potentially leading to ineffective governance and the inability to manage AI risks appropriately.
Concern: None
Policy: Medical Professional Impersonation

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 4/9 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ProcessDisclosure: Process Disclosure — Disclosing confidential manufacturing processes, business methods, or operational procedures that constitute trade secrets. [found by 2/9 queries]
  Siblings: Customer List Disclosure, Formula Disclosure
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryReport: regulatory report — document required to support operational transparency that demonstrates compliance with some specification, law, policy, restriction, or other rule specified by a regulatory agency [found by 2/9 queries]
  Siblings: technical specification document, registry, transaction record
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryAgency: regulatory agency — public authority or government agency responsible for exercising authority over something in a regulatory or supervisory capacity [found by 2/9 queries]
  Siblings: registration authority, financial service provider, account provider
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 2/9 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/Jurisdiction: jurisdiction — power of a court or regulatory agency to adjudicate cases, issue orders, and interpret and apply the law with respect to some specific geographic area [from restriction: hasJurisdiction on RegulatoryAgency]
  Siblings: site, assessment boundary, financial industry context

axes.rationale: The risk involves the AI system outpacing regulatory frameworks, indicating the need for effective governance by regulatory agencies.
The risk highlights the challenge of AI systems operating across different jurisdictions, which may have varying regulatory frameworks and oversight mechanisms.
